author: Neuralink
description:
Elon Musk shares his vision for Neuralink and one of its primary objectives: reducing human suffering. 

Through the VOICE clinical trial, we are seeing how brain-computer interfaces could help restore speech to those who have lost it due to ALS.

Click here to see the full video: https://youtu.be/u8mmn9lOIyw

Note: Neuralink devices are investigational and are not commercially available or FDA approved. There are no guaranteed benefits from participating in a Neuralink clinical trial.
title: Restoring Speech With Telepathy
